source.name: Moxie
source.originalDescription: When the user deals damage with auto attacks or moves, vibes increase, which increase Attack by 5% per stack up to 3. If no vibes are gained within 3s, they are lost, along with the user's boosted gauge. After evolving into Quaquaval, the next auto attack when vibes are maxed becomes Spinning Edge. Each time Spinning Edge hits opposing Pokémon, the user's movement speed is increased by 15% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Moxie は 移動速度を上げる、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: The user kicks at opposing Pokémon dealing damage. Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, with the user stepping in for a kick with increased damage. Spinning Edge deals damage 3 times in an area around the user over time, before rapidly dealing damage 3 more times. If Low Sweep was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will do increased damage. If Liquidation was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will grant a shield on use. If Carnival Splash was used preceding Spinning Edge, it will gain both effects.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は シールドを付与する、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。

source.name: Carnival Splash
source.originalDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable while dancing in place, gaining a shield and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon up to 3 times. The third hit will pull in opposing Pokémon towards the user, stunning them for 1s. Each opposing Pokémon pulled in grants the user a shield, up to 3 times. The third hit of this move will not affect wild Pokémon. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Carnival Splash は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、相手を引き寄せる、妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、野生ポケモン限定の処理を持つ。
